column3: “They were handled” is rendered “pressed,” and “they squeezed” as “handled.”
“Under me” is rendered “while she was Mine,” and “warriors” as “her neighbors”; the word is uncertain.
“Squeezed the nipples” is rendered “handled her virgin bosom.”
“Warriors” is rendered “the ones near,” and “clothed of perfection” as “magnificently dressed.”
“Overhung of turbans” is rendered “flowing turbans,” and “officers” follows a rare word.
“Alienated my self” is rendered “I became disgusted.”
“Since Egypt” is rendered “the Egyptians,” and NASB follows a slightly different reading.
“Pekod, Shoa, and Koa” are kept as names; they may be titles.
“Weapon” is a rare word; “wheels” is rendered “wagons.”
“Articles of your beauty” is rendered “beautiful jewels.”
“They have done” is rendered as future, “will be done.”
